policy: Verified positive and negative news feeds a bounded, time-decaying simulation overlay; base assumptions remain owner-controlled.

items.headline: O — wind-down contract for Cursor by Nov 12, 2026
items.summary: O said it will wind down its contract providing models to Cursor, proposing a shutoff date of Nov 12, 2026. The change also cited accountability tied to upcoming “Astra” usage terms.

items.headline: V — pre-IPO valuation snapshot updated (market comps)
items.summary: Pre-IPO valuation trackers updated V’s valuation data (including a latest-round snapshot) as of Aug 25, 2026, reflecting shifting private-market pricing signals rather than a newly disclosed deal.

items.headline: O — cyber-critical readiness notes for GPT-5.6 (Sol/Luna)
items.summary: O’s Deployment Safety Hub updated August readiness for GPT-5.6 Sol and GPT-5.6 Luna as “High capability” across cybersecurity and biological/chemical domains, under its Preparedness Framework.

items.headline: O — Astra flagged near critical cyber threshold; development pacing
items.summary: O published a cyber-capabilities update describing the O–Hugging Face incident and stating preliminary evidence that upcoming “Astra” may meet the “Critical cybersecurity capability threshold,” prompting pauses/adjustments.

items.headline: G — closes $350M Series A at ~$3.5B valuation
items.summary: G announced a $350M Series A led by Disruptive, with planned participation from NVIDIA, valuing the company at about $3.5B (per accompanying coverage).

items.headline: G — becomes an NVIDIA Cloud Partner
items.summary: G announced it became an NVIDIA Cloud Partner, positioning the deal as expanding full-stack alignment for running inference infrastructure and supporting customers’ deployments.
